posts.en: Heading back to Washington, D.C., from China. It was a Great and Highly Consequential Trip. I will be giving a News Conference tomorrow at 12 P.M., the White House. Also, will be discussing the Trade Deals with Thailand, the Philippines, and others. President DONALD J. TRUMP
posts.zh: 正從中國返回華盛頓特區。這是一次偉大且極具重大意義的訪問。我將於明天中午12點在白宮舉行新聞發布會。此外，我將討論與泰國、菲律賓及其他國家的貿易協議。唐納德·J·川普總統

posts.en: I am now heading to China, from the Philippines, where we had a wonderful meeting on Trade, National Security, and other subjects. I am pleased to announce that we made a new and completely different Trade Deal with the Philippines, one that will be a true landmark and, in particular, a Deal that will be great for our Farmers and those in the business of "Energy." President Marcos is a powerful leader, and a man of high integrity and substance. It was an Honor to be with him, and his beautiful wife and son. See you in China! President DONALD J. TRUMP
posts.zh: 我現在正從菲律賓前往中國，我們在那裡就貿易、國家安全及其他議題進行了精彩的會談。我很高興地宣布，我們與菲律賓達成了新的、完全不同的貿易協議，這將是一個真正的里程碑，特別是對我們的農民和「能源」行業從業者來說，這將是一項極具意義的協議。馬科斯總統是一位強有力的領導人，也是一位品格高尚、實事求是的人。能與他、他美麗的妻子和兒子在一起，是我的榮幸。中國見！唐納德·J·川普總統
